content: i used the needle nosepliers to pull the belts made it much easier

So this part was just brutal with all the tension on the belts, even with the tension pulleys as loose as possible. So i just unscrewed them fully to give lots of slack, and just secured these belts the same way as the other side to be able to line it up in the groove just right, and then re-attached the two tension pulleys. Much easier.

replies.content: same here... done this before when assembling the original kit
Agreed, this was the easiest way to do it. Impossible to get them at equal lenghts otherwise.
Agreed. I tried to do it with the tensioners attached and later during belt calibration, the belt slipped out... Now I have to disassemble a bunch of stuff just to reattach the belt. What a pain
